Drag audio files here or pick them from your computer.

list.label: Sounds

settings.title: Settings
settings.output.title: Audio output
settings.output.desc: Where sounds play: headphones, speakers or a virtual cable (like VB-Cable) to send them to Discord or a stream.
settings.master.title: Master volume
settings.master.desc: Scales the volume of every sound. Each sound's own volume is still adjustable in the list.
settings.exclusive.title: One sound at a time
settings.exclusive.desc: Playing a sound cuts off whatever is playing. When off, sounds overlap.
settings.stop.title: Stop all
settings.stop.desc: Stops every sound from anywhere, even with the app in the background and in any profile. Click the key to change it; <kbd>Backspace</kbd> removes it.
settings.keyboard.title: Sound keyboard
settings.keyboard.desc: Pick a keyboard (for example, a USB numpad) so only it triggers sounds. The same keys on other keyboards stay free; Ctrl, Alt and Shift work from any of them.
settings.close.title: When closing the window
settings.login.title: Start with the system
settings.backup.title: Back up everything
settings.backup.desc: Saves all profiles, sounds and settings in a .soundboard file, to move to another computer or restore later. The audio output and the chosen keyboard are left out, since they depend on the computer.
settings.theme.title: Theme
settings.theme.desc: Light, dark or the same as the system, switching by itself when the system does.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.desc: Language of Soundboard's text. Same as the system uses Portuguese if the system is in Portuguese, and English otherwise.
drop.title: Drop to add
drop.text: Audio files open to pick the clip and the key; .soundboard files become profiles
editor.name: Name
capture.hint:
You can combine it with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Cmd.
Esc cancels · Backspace removes the binding
tab.title: Click to open · double-click the name to rename
row.name: Edit name, clip and key
keyWarn.failed: The system didn't let {key} be used as a global shortcut (another program already uses it). It only works with Soundboard focused.
keyWarn.numlock: NumLock is off, so {key} only works with Soundboard focused. Turn NumLock on.
toast.outputMissing: Audio output unavailable, playing on the default output
settings.login.desc: Opens Soundboard hidden in the tray when you log in, with the keys already working.
settings.login.dev: Only works in the installed app (with npm start, the system would open Electron without Soundboard).
settings.close.descMac: If it keeps running, the keys keep working with the window closed; reopen it from the Dock icon and quit with Cmd+Q.
settings.close.desc: If it keeps running, the keys keep working with the window closed. Soundboard stays in the icon near the clock, where you can reopen it, switch profiles or quit.
stopKey.title: Key to stop all sounds (works as a global shortcut)
row.key.title: Click to change the key
row.noKey: This sound has no key: it only plays with the ▶ button. Click "No key" to bind one.
tab.key.title: Key to open this profile (works from any profile)

toast.numlock: Turn NumLock on: with it off, the numpad only works with the app focused
toast.keyInUse: {key} is already used by the system — it only works with the app focused
toast.focusOnly: {key} only works with the app focused: the system has no global shortcut for this key
editor.keyPick: Click and press the key that will play the sound
toast.loginRefused: The system didn't let Soundboard start by itself
update.manualMac: On the Mac, updating means downloading the new version and installing it over this one (updating by itself would require Apple's paid signing).
update.manual: With this install (portable or .deb), updating means downloading the new version and installing it over this one.
update.idle: Soundboard checks for new versions by itself when it opens and every 6 hours.
update.ready: Version {version} has been downloaded. Restart to update, or it installs when you quit the app.
update.available: Version {version} is available. Your sounds, profiles and settings stay after installing.
notice.title: Soundboard is still running
notice.mac: To open it again, click its icon in the Dock. To quit, use Cmd+Q.
notice.tray: To open it or quit, use the icon near the clock (it may be hidden under the ^ arrow).
restore.detail: Merge keeps your profiles and adds the ones in the file. Replace deletes the current profiles and sounds and applies the backup's settings.
import.notSoundboard: This file isn't a Soundboard export
import.newer: The file comes from a newer Soundboard version; update the app to import it
zip.too-big: The file would exceed 4 GB, the .soundboard limit
zip.unsupported: The .soundboard was compressed in a way the app can't read
